outside_sources.title: Blender Manual — Distribute Points on Faces
outside_sources.author: Blender Documentation Team / Blender Foundation

technique_notes: GeometryNodeDistributePointsOnFaces distribute_method='RANDOM' — uniform density before culling
POINT-domain attributes are bilinearly interpolated to distributed points automatically
No Capture Attribute node required — Named Attribute reads from the flowing geometry context
FunctionNodeCompare data_type='FLOAT' operation='GREATER_EQUAL': A=random, B=density → delete mask
GeometryNodeDeleteGeometry domain='POINT' mode='ALL' removes probability-failed points
GeometryNodeRandomValue FLOAT_VECTOR for per-instance random Z rotation in Instance on Points
GeometryNodeRealizeInstances mandatory before export_apply=True for correct GLB geometry
ObjectInfo transform_space='RELATIVE' keeps prop centred on its own origin
